maintainer lands them:

  https://github.com/kinto-technologies/message-sweeper/issues/new/choose

Bug reports, feature ideas and translations are all very welcome there. See

**Message Sweeper does not accept pull requests.** Please open an
[Issue](https://github.com/kinto-technologies/message-sweeper/issues/new/choose)
instead — bug reports, feature ideas and translations are all welcome, and a
maintainer will take it from there. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/kinto-technologies/message-sweeper/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for details.
